description.value: Local Public Eatery Kamloops is a lively chain pub and restaurant set in a commercial area of the city, pouring a rotating lineup of BC craft beers from multiple taps alongside a full food menu. The location features a spacious patio for outdoor seating and multiple TVs for catching live sports. An online ordering system is in place, making it a practical stop for a sit-down meal or a quick takeout on a riding day.
